why: Seeded 18-09-2026 in the commit that adopts the rule. Every entry carries its MEASUREMENT rather than a bare name [R-ENF-08], so the debt is countable and an entry names its own fix: one sentence from beta_regression.estimator_note(), emitted beside the diagnostics the document already prints. The list may only SHORTEN. THE EXEMPLAR IS NOT ON IT — ADNOCLS names the construction in its own cost-of-capital table ('The estimate is a lead-lag sum beta: the routine regresses on one lag, the contemporaneous return and one lead and sums the three slopes'), so per [R-ENF-01 EXTENDED 04-Sep-2026] this standard is MET by the exemplar rather than added to its debt.
